projects.title: Rabbit digestion in hot and cold weather: what the evidence supports
projects.label: Rabbit digestion and weather
projects.summary: Heat is the best-studied weather threat to rabbit digestion. Betaine has more rabbit trials than any other heat additive, with gut-marker benefits but mixed growth results. Common electrolyte doses have no trials behind them, and cold-weather evidence is thin.
projects.card_title: Rabbit digestion and weather: a research review
projects.card_excerpt: What studies say about hot and cold weather, feeding and gut health—and where the evidence is still limited.

projects.title: Feline urinary health: an evidence review of food, water and repeat blockage
projects.label: Feline urinary health
projects.summary: Inspect the food, water and repeat-blockage evidence, with corrected denominators, endpoint distinctions and methods limits.
projects.seo_title: Feline urinary health: food, water and recurrence evidence
projects.description: A bounded review of published feline urinary research: food, water, repeat blockage, study populations, source access and the limits of the synthesis.
projects.card_title: Cat urinary health: treatment and prevention research
projects.card_excerpt: A review of research on food, water, medicines and repeat urinary problems—with the limits explained.
